messages:
maya_sales: Acme POC follow-up: they need a single-paragraph SOW line for USB delivery that covers signing, SBOM, upgrade cadence, rollback, and hotfix SLA. Can we agree text and a 1-page ops checklist?
liam_se: Draft SOW line: "Redwood will provide signed bundle artifacts (detached HSM-backed signatures), SBOMs, and a documented offline apply & rollback runbook. Regular releases quarterly with monthly security deltas; emergency signed artifacts available under Enterprise Support." (we can refine).
tori_sre: Ops checklist (short): verify checksums & signature; create pre-apply snapshot; dry-run apply; apply; smoke tests; emit signed apply receipt. Commands we suggest:
```
sha256sum -c redwood.manifest && openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
./redwood-apply --bundle bundle.tar.gz --verify --dry-run --emit-receipt > apply.receipt
```
maya_sales: Good. Acme also asked about billing: do we charge on delivery or on applied install? They prefer applied.
liam_se: Billing opt: (A) bill on delivery (simpler), (B) bill on applied install if customer uploads signed apply.receipt within 14 days. We can include offline receipt workflow in SOW.
alan_legal: Contract bullets: include expedited-signing fee table and clause: "Expedited Signed Artifact: Redwood will produce a signed artifact within 24 hours for Enterprise Support when expedited fee is paid; Redwood is not liable for physical transport delays. Customer must accept chain-of-custody provisions for physical media." Also add export-control reminder for cryptographic components.
tori_sre: Technical caveat: for large models we recommend chunking (<=40GB parts) + resumable apply. If a patch changes quantization or model format, KV cache migration may be required and we should flag possible increased downtime.
maya_sales: Can someone drop the one-pager + final SOW sentence here by EOD? I'll send to Acme. :pray:
chain-bot: chain-bot: created ticket SALES-9999 (deliverables: 1-page ops checklist, SOW sentence, expedited fee table, offline receipt workflow).
liam_se: I'll post the one-pager draft in ~2h with exact phrasing and example commands.
alan_legal: I'll post the contract snippet for the expedited clause and the Signing Kit Addendum by EOD.
maya_sales: Thanks team 44d will consolidate and send once drafts are in.
